sloka: अपि मे गुरुणा रामः पूजितः कुशिकात्मज ।इह आगतो महातेजाः पूजाम् प्राप्य महात्मनः ॥१-५१-८॥
transliteration: api me guruṇā rāmaḥ pūjitaḥ kuśikātmaja ।iha āgato mahātejāḥ pūjām prāpya mahātmanaḥ ॥1-51-8॥

translations.english: O Son of Kushika was Rama honoured by my father? Was my most brilliant father honoured by illustrious Rama when he arrived?
